title: Make sure nothing in Engram core still needs a live gated-control session when the host runs with gated control OFF
outcome: Make sure nothing in Engram core still needs a live gated-control session when the host runs with gated control OFF
acceptance: A source inventory lists every Engram core path that reads or requires control-session state (control_sessions phase, connection token, routing token, grants) and that an ordinary OFF-mode host operation can reach, with file:line and whether it blocks ordinary work

Every inventoried path that blocks ordinary work under OFF (claim, note, gate, evaluate, done, named-root binding for acceptance evaluation) is either removed from the OFF path or covered by a supported OFF-mode route that the host actually uses, with a test that exercises it on a store holding real retained control state (exited session, expired or completed grants)
Under OFF, an acceptance evaluation of a claimed item can be recorded and completion can proceed without any turn grant or gated admission, demonstrated end-to-end with TermAl's OFF-mode build
No path grants gated authority, replays an old operation, or treats an old unknown operation's settlement as a precondition
